checks.message: Repository provisional boundary is explicitly marked official_boundary=false and provisional_constraint; it is eligible for intake but is not an official redline or precise approval basis.
All three required key areas are present and non-overlapping, but remain provisional constraints pending official polygons.
Conceptual land-use envelopes cover the provisional site without gaps or overlaps; the 1.0 ratio is a topology check, not an approved land-use allocation.

A verified existing-building inventory is unavailable. The layer now contains 18 explicitly schematic/not-approved test-fit envelopes; every actual retain, adapt, demolish, or infill decision remains pending building-by-building evidence.
Unknown baselines use null values with reasons; proposal targets, gates, scenarios, and conceptual measurements are labelled not_approved.
Chinese and English proposals have matching heading depth, evidence-reference multisets, nineteen paired figures, rendered HTML, 20-page A3 booklets, and five-page A0 board sets.

The offline bilingual visualization presents one continuous professional report with nineteen context-linked figure pairs, local assets only, and explicit provisional/not-approved evidence boundaries.
Chinese and English A3 booklets contain 20 pages each; Chinese and English A0 board sets contain five pages each. All four PDFs retain extractable text and remain below the package size limit.
Deterministic validation, spatial, visual, professional, bilingual, portability, and integrated-package audits passed in the final package state.
Official approximate values for 43.6 km², about 11.4 km², 368.4 ha, and all three key-area areas are separately registered from provisional geometry; exact official polygons remain missing.
The seven-layer industry stack, three-area/two-wing conversion loop, five mechanism cases, and six reciprocal compacts are present with non-extrapolation and non-approval boundaries.

Station-to-destination complete journeys, construction states, detour review, basic-service baskets, utility capacity, and safe-degradation gates are all addressed with field baselines still pending.
The built Jing-Zhang public realm is treated as an operating and performance spine, with access, hydrology, habitat, culture, and maintenance evaluated without duplicate claims of public investment.

Zhongzhiyuan, AI Origin, and Dazhongsi each have a distinct plan sequence, six typological envelopes, intensity band, public interface, access logic, scenario nodes, section logic, and stop conditions.
The parent identity, bilingual name, reciprocal-rail mark logic, color/status grammar, three positioning levels, and five functional responses are documented without implying official endorsement.
Five public-institution mechanism cases are individually translated with explicit non-transferable powers and are tied to the local industry and operating model.

Three non-spectacle landmarks, a segment-verifiable public route, daily roles, shared SLA, accessibility, quiet-time, and removal/restoration gates are specified as unapproved operations.
The Engineering Self-Reliance to Public Intelligence narrative, three traceable landmarks, correction rights, multi-format interpretation, and heritage-first stop gates are documented.

Reciprocity Seasons, five developer-member types, four-layer governance, eight-step scenario access, annual landmark budget scenarios, and the eight-stage international funnel are complete and not approved.
Every metric provenance reference used for the current package resolves inside the submission; future field registers remain explicitly marked not_collected and are not treated as current evidence.
Height and massing sensitivity, active public ground floors, quiet cultural edges, heritage controls, bilingual wayfinding, and non-spectacle landmark rules form a reviewable character framework.
